answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of the WebWalker, built on various mainstream LLMs, using WebWalkerQA as the benchmark...

answer_2.quote: using questionanswering accuracy (acc.) as the performance metric and the action count (A.C.) of successful agentic executions answering correctly as the efficiency metric.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 as the evaluator, which determines the correctness of responses by comparing the predicted answer with the ground truth using CoT prompting strategy.
